title.value: Bigger, Better, Faster: Human-level Atari with human-level efficiency
title.justification: The title of the paper is straightforwardly provided in the manuscript and is used to identify its primary focus.
title.quote: Bigger, Better, Faster: Human-level Atari with human-level efficiency

extractions.description: This paper introduces the BBF, a value-based reinforcement learning agent that achieves super-human performance on the Atari 100K benchmark. The agent relies on scaling neural networks for value estimation and explores various design choices for achieving this efficiently. The paper conducts analyses of these design choices and suggests updates for sample-efficient RL research guidelines.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper's central theme is about improving reinforcement learning techniques for efficiency in gaming benchmarks, which primarily revolves around machine learning advancements, without explicit focus on climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We introduce a value-based RL agent, which we call BBF, that achieves super-human performance in the Atari 100K benchmark.
